subject.title: feat(mattermost): add thread.requireExplicitMention to opt out of thread auto-follow

question: Should Mattermost permanently expose an account-level `thread.requireExplicitMention` configuration contract to disable participated-thread auto-follow?
rationale: The implementation is narrow and default-preserving, but OpenClaw policy sets a high bar for new configuration surfaces and alternatives include an explicit thread-disengage command or a finer room-level control.

options.title: Accept Slack-parity config
options.body: Add the optional default-false key, complete public documentation and observable Mattermost proof, then land the bounded gate change.

options.title: Prefer disengage control
options.body: Keep automatic thread participation as policy and instead design a command or action that clears participation for a specific thread.

options.title: Require room-level policy
options.body: Narrow the setting to Mattermost group/channel configuration rather than applying it to every room for an account.

recommendation.title: Accept Slack-parity config
recommendation.body: Add the optional default-false key, complete public documentation and observable Mattermost proof, then land the bounded gate change.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the participated-thread policy and are best positioned to confirm whether this opt-out matches its intended product boundary.
